blocks.text: A species is the basic unit of biological classification. It refers to “a group of organisms that share similar physical and genetic characteristics and, most importantly, can interbreed to produce fertile offspring”. For example, The Indus River Dolphin is a distinct species. All Indus dolphins can breed with one another, but they cannot breed with other types of dolphins to produce fertile young.
